patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: The waiter SWORE there was no shrimp in the pad thai. My face is filing a formal dispute. Also I can hear myself wheezing now, which is a sound I've decided I hate.
clinical.presentationShort: 27yo F — facial/lip swelling + wheeze minutes after shellfish.
clinical.presentationLong: 27-year-old female, facial and lip swelling with wheeze minutes after eating shellfish.

diagnosis.primary: Anaphylaxis (shellfish) with airway edema and hypotension
diagnosis.disposition: Resus → IM epinephrine NOW, high-flow O2, IV fluids for the low pressure, antihistamines + steroids, watch for a biphasic rebound
diagnosis.why: Epi goes in the thigh, not on the back burner. Airway swelling plus shock = ESI 1, no negotiating. 🦐
